1479-4826-5700-5701-8338.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-8338.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4247-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
4247-5254-8122.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
4247-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

628-1947-2018.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-8095.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-5870.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-5870.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

475-3263-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3263-5641-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

153-1636-5996.easyPrerequisites:
Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two cards in hand.
153-1636-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
153-1636-5996.description:
Activate Jolrael by paying {2}{G}, tapping it and discarding two cards, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

944-2034-2048-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

2033-3459-5078-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3558-4053-5147-6989.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

339-677-5256-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

874-2866-4986-5315.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4986-5315.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1274-3197-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6720.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

955-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
955-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

864-1312-2034-4871-5223.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

575-861-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one white card in hand.
575-861-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Watcher of the Roost, adding one mana of any color.
When Watcher of the Roost dies, Yedora triggers, returning Watcher of the Roost from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Watcher of the Roost's morph ability by revealing a white card from your hand, turning it face up.
Watcher of the Roost triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2034-2192-4044-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Roterothopter, adding {C}{C}.
When Roterothopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Roterothopter on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Roterothopter from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1346-2743-3280.description:
Cast Repeated Reverberation by paying {2}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Repeated Reverberation triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Croaking Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary that are 1/1 Frogs.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2275-2353-4691.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2275-2353-4691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet and Shabraz trigger.
Resolve the Shabraz trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2074-4050-4417-4871.notablePrerequisites: Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2074-4050-4417-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vorapede, adding {B}.
Vorapede dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Vorapede trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

553-715-1403-3212.description:
Move to your draw step, drawing Approach of the Second Sun and revealing it due to God-Eternal Kefnet's ability.
Resolve God-Eternal Kefnet's trigger, copying Approach of the Second Sun and casting the copy from your hand by paying {4}{W}.
Sunbird's Invocation triggers.
Holding priority, activate Conch Horn by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, drawing two cards and then putting Approach of the Second Sun on top of your library.
Resolve the Sunbird's Invocation trigger, revealing the top seven cards of your library, casting Approach of the Second Sun without paying its mana cost, then putting the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Approach of the Second Sun, putting it back into your library seventh from the top and gaining you 7 life.
Resolve the remaining copy of Approach of the Second Sun.
